description: This PHP source file defines the class SugarFieldFile which extends SugarFieldBase to implement file handling functionalities within the SuiteCRM framework. It includes methods for rendering detail, edit, and search views, as well as saving uploaded files, managing file duplication and remote linking, and overriding list view rendering.

classes.name: SugarFieldFile
classes.description: Defines the file field handling logic for SuiteCRM, including view rendering and file upload management.

methods.name: fillInOptions
methods.description: Populates the vardef and displayParams arrays with default values and overrides needed for file field configuration.

methods.name: getDetailViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares display parameters and invokes parent method to render detail view for the file field.

methods.name: getEditViewSmarty
methods.description: Prepares display parameters and invokes parent method to render edit view for the file field, including access keys.

methods.name: getSearchViewSmarty
methods.description: Renders the search view for the file field.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles the saving process for uploaded files, managing uploads, duplicates, remote links, and related metadata.

methods.name: getListViewSmarty
methods.description: Customizes list view rendering for the file field, ensuring the module context is set.
